general.notes: Power budget 0 – 12 dB stated in technical summary. Transmitter output power min/max and receiver minimum input power and overload are average power (footnote 1). Receiver minimum input power -21.0 dBm and overload -3.0 dBm at 1.25 Gbps, BER ≤ 1×10⁻¹², PRBS 2⁷-1, back-to-back (footnote 2). Operating temperature: 0°C to +70°C (C-temp); SO-SFP-1000Base-MMXD-I and duplicate line list -40°C to +85°C (I-temp). Power consumption stated as < 1.0 W.
